messages.content: Decide whether the evidence quote supports the claim, judging ONLY from the quote. SUPPORTED: the quote clearly establishes the claim. CONTRADICTED: the quote states something incompatible with the claim. NOT_SUPPORTED: the quote is related but does not establish the claim. Give a one-sentence rationale first.

CLAIM: More than half of the surveyed students preferred asyncio.
QUOTE: Of the 40 students surveyed, 18 preferred asyncio, 15 preferred threads and 7 had no preference.
